# 1. Data Preprocessing

```{r}
experiment_phase <- c("L122136")
file_name <- paste0("../../data/",experiment_phase,"/experiment_results.csv")
```


## a) Task data

```{r}
task <- read_csv(file_name)
names(task) <- make.names(names(task))
task <- task %>%
  rename(
    experimentName = Experiment.Name,
    subject_id = prolificPid
    ) %>%
  filter(experimentName %in% experiment_phase) %>%
  mutate(
    Caught = as.integer(Caught == "Yes"),
    Angle = ifelse(Angle > 360, Angle - 360, Angle),
    Noise_Condition = ifelse(Std == 12, "Low_Noise", "High_Noise")
  ) 
task$Noise_Condition <- factor(task$Noise_Condition, levels = c("Low_Noise","High_Noise"))


## Include only participants with complete (300) trials
participant_trial_counts <- task %>%
  group_by(experimentName, subject_id) %>%
  summarise(trials = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(trials == 300)

task <- task %>%
  semi_join(participant_trial_counts, by = c("experimentName", "subject_id")) %>%
  select( -c(experimentName))


```

## b) Questionnaire data

```{r}
quest <- read_csv(paste0("../../data/",experiment_phase,"/questionnaire_data.csv"))
```

# 2. Apply exclusion filter

```{r}
## TECHNICAL EXCLUSIONS

# Did not complete task/questionnaire
exclusion_ids_incomplete <- setdiff(unique(task$subject_id), quest$subject_id)
paste("N incomplete:", length(exclusion_ids_incomplete))

# Confidence == 0 on any trial
exclusion_ids_conf0 <- task %>%
  filter(Confidence == 0) %>%
  pull(subject_id) %>%
  unique()

paste("N confidence == 0:", length(exclusion_ids_conf0))

# Check how many times confidence ratings can equal to the intital confidence by chance (alpha = .99)
p <- 1/20 ## equal to all possible confidence ratings bw 5 and 100 with step size 5
n_trials <- 30
binom.test(n_trials, 300, p = p,
           alternative = "greater")
task_count <- task %>% filter(Initial.Confidence == Confidence) %>% count(subject_id)
task_count %>% filter(n >= n_trials)
exclusion_ids_initconf <- task_count %>%
  filter(n >= n_trials) %>%
  pull(subject_id) %>%
  unique()
paste("N conf == init.conf:", length(exclusion_ids_initconf))

# Combine technical exclusions
exclusion_ids <- union(exclusion_ids_incomplete,exclusion_ids_conf0)
#exclusion_ids <- union(exclusion_ids,exclusion_ids_initconf)

paste("Total technical exclusions:", length(exclusion_ids))



## DEMOGRAPHICS AFTER TECHNICAL EXCLUSIONS

quest_demographics <- quest %>%
  filter(!subject_id %in% exclusion_ids) %>%
  mutate(age = abs(as.numeric(age)))

# Age
summary(quest_demographics$age)
sd(quest_demographics$age, na.rm = TRUE)

# Gender
table(quest_demographics$gender)
prop.table(table(quest_demographics$gender)) * 100



## 1. Did not pass attention check
exclusion_ids_att <- quest %>%
  filter((att1 != 7) | (att2 != 1)) %>%
  pull(subject_id)

exclusion_ids <- union(exclusion_ids, exclusion_ids_att)

paste("N subjects to remove:", length(exclusion_ids_att))


## 2. Did not adjust default confidence in > 60% of trials
n_trials <- 300 * 0.6
task_count <- task %>% filter(Initial.Confidence == Confidence) %>% count(subject_id)
exclusion_ids_nonadjust <- task_count %>% filter(n > n_trials) %>% pull(subject_id)

exclusion_ids <- union(exclusion_ids, exclusion_ids_nonadjust)
paste("N subjects to remove:", length(exclusion_ids_nonadjust))


## 3. > 0.5 correlation between default confidence and confidence 
task$conf_sc <-ave(task$Confidence, task$subject_id, FUN=scale)
task$def.conf_sc <-ave(task$Initial.Confidence, task$subject_id, FUN=scale)

actConf<-lmer(def.conf_sc ~ 0 + conf_sc + (0 + conf_sc |subject_id),
              data=task)
corr_init_conf <- as.data.frame(coef(actConf)[[1]])
exclusion_ids_05 <- row.names(corr_init_conf %>% filter(conf_sc > 0.50))

exclusion_ids <- union(exclusion_ids, exclusion_ids_05)
paste("N subjects to remove:", length(exclusion_ids_05))


## 4. Lower mean confidence where the previous trial was correct compared to incorrect

check_df <- task %>%
  select(subject_id, ID, Stage, Caught, Confidence) %>%
  group_by(subject_id, Stage) %>%
  arrange(ID, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Next_Confidence = lead(Confidence)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Next_Confidence)

check_summary <- check_df %>%
  group_by(subject_id, Caught) %>%
  summarise(
    m.conf = mean(Next_Confidence),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Caught, values_from = m.conf) %>%
  mutate(diff = `1` - `0`)

exclusion_ids_lowerconf <- check_summary %>%
  filter(diff < 0) %>%
  pull(subject_id)

paste("N subjects to remove:", length(exclusion_ids_lowerconf))
#exclusion_ids <- union(exclusion_ids, exclusion_ids_lowerconf)



paste("Total N to remove:", length(exclusion_ids))
```

```{r}
# Exclude subjects from individual data sets

task <- task %>% filter(!(subject_id %in% exclusion_ids))
quest <- quest %>% filter(!(subject_id %in% exclusion_ids))
mood <- mood %>% filter(!(subject_id %in% exclusion_ids))

```

# 4. Prepare modelling data

```{r}
circDiff_abs <- function(a, b) {
  d <- abs(a - b)
  valid <- !is.na(d)
  d[valid & d > 180] <- 360 - d[valid & d > 180]
  return(d)
}
```

```{r}
# 1. Calculate action and PE
mod_df <- task %>%
  group_by(subject_id, Stage) %>% ### restrict calculations to blocks
  mutate(
    Bucket.Position.Next = lead(Bucket.Position),
    action = circDiff_abs(Bucket.Position.Next, Bucket.Position),
    pe = circDiff_abs(Bucket.Position, Angle),
    conf = lead(Confidence) # For confidence, delete first trial, so that confidence(t1) aligns with pe(t0) and action(t0)
  ) %>% filter(ID != 100) ### delete last trial of each block, since no action exists for block1, trial100 -> block2, trial1

# 2. Calculate ranked action and pe
mod_df <- mod_df %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  mutate(
    ranked_PE = ave(pe, subject_id, FUN=rank),
    ranked_conf = ave(conf, subject_id, FUN=rank),
    ranked_action = ave(action, subject_id, FUN=rank)
  )

# 3. Scale behavioral variables
mod_df$conf_sc <-ave(mod_df$conf, mod_df$subject_id, FUN=scale)
mod_df$pe_sc <-ave(mod_df$pe, mod_df$subject_id, FUN=scale) 
mod_df$action_sc <-ave(mod_df$action, mod_df$subject_id, FUN=scale) 

mod_df$conf_rank_sc <- ave(mod_df$ranked_conf, mod_df$subject_id, FUN=scale)
mod_df$pe_rank_sc <-ave(mod_df$ranked_PE, mod_df$subject_id, FUN=scale) 
mod_df$action_rank_sc <-ave(mod_df$ranked_action, mod_df$subject_id, FUN=scale)

# 4. Organize & clean df
mod_df <- mod_df %>%
  select(c(subject_id, Stage, ID, Mean, Angle, Bucket.Position, Caught, Noise_Condition,
           pe, action, conf,
           pe_sc, action_sc, conf_sc,
           ranked_PE, ranked_action, ranked_conf,
           pe_rank_sc, action_rank_sc, conf_rank_sc))

# 5. Save modelling df
write_csv(mod_df, "../../data/L122136/cleaned/modelling_data.csv")
```
